problem_boundary.old_story_gap: The existing random-baseline story shows lower future pass-rate MAE than same-budget random sampling, but the original Selection benchmark tied Codex + GPT mainline and Kilo + GPT mainline at 15/20. A user-facing Agent-selection story needs a preregistered recommend/abstain decision and later/Holdout validation, not only aggregate MAE.

available_score_tables.exclusion_reason: Historical 900s Kilo timeout path is useful context but not a valid scoreable final validation grid.
Single smoke task is a reliability gate, not a later/Holdout evaluation slice.

missing_cell_assessment.selection_common_grid: complete rows for four demo Agents; two Agents have two non-scoreable cells each, handled by the preregistered invalid-cell policy
missing_cell_assessment.holdout_common_grid: complete and fully scoreable for four demo Agents
missing_cell_assessment.doubled_timeout_top2_repeat_grid: complete and fully scoreable for Codex + GPT mainline and Kilo + GPT mainline

initial_budgets.purpose: current Selection size; detects whether a selector degenerates to the original quality tie
smaller sensitivity and final no-paid candidate; leaves enough random-sampling variance for strong baselines while meeting the default minimum common-valid threshold

frozen_no_paid_replay_plan.candidate_pool: original frozen Selection task IDs from experiments/agent_selection_demo/results/frozen_split.json
frozen_no_paid_replay_plan.final_later_slice: original Holdout for four-Agent decision metrics, with doubled-timeout top-2 repeat used as the reliability-gated top-pair validation
selector_visibility: task metadata available before the original holdout
task source, task_time, source cluster, module/path bucket, test path bucket, change-size proxy
no Selection task outcome cells before task IDs are selected
no Holdout or doubled-timeout repeat outcomes before the final selector config is frozen
frozen_no_paid_replay_plan.leakage_avoidance: Selectors select task IDs from metadata and deterministic fallback features only. Evaluation joins Selection outcomes only after the selected IDs are fixed; final later/Holdout outcomes are never used for scoring or retuning selectors.
